text:
You need a highly organized virtual administrative assistant who can keep calendars, communication, reports, and project details moving smoothly in a fast-paced remote setting.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be glad to support you with dependable administrative help for up to 10 hours a week. I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, along with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my background is rooted in reporting and analytics, that experience has made me highly detail-oriented, structured, and comfortable handling information accurately and on time.

In my Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. The result was a clearer, centralized reporting process that consolidated 14 reports into 1 and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project required organizing data, maintaining accuracy, coordinating moving parts, and presenting information clearly—skills that translate well to administrative support, scheduling, reporting, and keeping workflows on track.

I’m comfortable working in Google Sheets and Excel, preparing organized reports, maintaining files, and helping ensure deadlines are met. I also understand the importance of discretion, clear communication, and dependable follow-through when supporting a busy professional. If needed, I can help keep information flowing accurately, assist with project tracking, and support general administrative tasks in a way that stays flexible and efficient.

What I would bring to your role is a steady, proactive approach: staying organized, keeping priorities visible, and making sure tasks are completed on time. I’m also comfortable adapting to your preferred workflow and communication style so the support feels seamless.

Could you share which calendar, email, and document tools you use most day to day so I can align with your workflow right away?
